name: Dromund Kalakar
description: Dromund Kalakar was a gas giant in the Dromund system. Its shipyards produced the VX-9 Mailoc gunship and F-T2 Quell, FT-3C Imperium and F-T6 Rycer strike fighters for the Sith Empire.
lead_paragraphs: Dromund Kalakar was a gas giant in the Dromund system. Its shipyards produced the VX-9 Mailoc gunship and F-T2 Quell, FT-3C Imperium and F-T6 Rycer strike fighters for the Sith Empire.
